Hi @Bettina Kroll, I couldn't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler isn't reachable from here: the automations call failed with "gateway cron.list requires credentials", so I can't create or check the recurring job. I haven't changed any gateway configuration.

Here's what I'd set up once the scheduler is reachable:

- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time (13:00 UTC), with the first post on Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted here in #coastal-team, built from #coastal-team and #coastal-random. You, Kwame and Sofia are in both channels, so nothing in the digest is new to anyone in this channel.
- **What:** last week's activity plus open customer items. Money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices) will be left out and handled directly with the account owner or finance, so they don't end up in a channel.

If someone on the gateway side can restore the scheduler's credentials, I'll create the job. Or, if you'd rather I post the first digest by hand on the 19th, I can do that instead.
